sections.h2: Maruti's e-Nagare cut plan-to-shopfloor time from about 30 hours to 2

chart.title: Digitising the production-plan sequence shortened the cycle sharply
chart.sub: Hours from vendor plan to shopfloor, as reported for Maruti Suzuki.
chart.source: Maruti Suzuki, as cited in the post.

sections.means: Just-in-time only works when the production sequence reaches suppliers quickly, and e-Nagare does that digitally.
sections.todo: Any new cluster should build this digital plan link before adding more suppliers, as the Maruti case suggests.

sections.h2: NCR's component base is mostly small MSMEs, unlike Pune and Chennai

chart.title: Most NCR component firms are Tier-2 or Tier-3 MSMEs, not large Tier-1s
chart.sub: Share of Delhi-Haryana (NCR) auto-component firms, %, roughly.

sections.means: A cluster can be close to its OEM yet still too small to absorb the working-capital demands of just-in-time supply.
sections.todo: Policy support for NCR suppliers should target that capital and technology gap, the post's central concern for this cluster.
